name: a2a-gateway
title_zh: 让两个 Agent 用 JSON-RPC 直接对话的
tagline_zh: 你的 Agent 还在靠人肉转发消息？装上它，Agent 之间就能点对点互聊，不用再经过你的对话框。
tagline_en: Agents still chatting through you? This gateway lets them talk peer-to-peer over JSON-RPC, no human relay.
desc_en: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol gateway reference. JSON-RPC 2.0 peer-to-peer agent communication. (/a2a-gateway, a2a, agent protocol)
why_zh: 它把 A2A 协议做成了可挂载的网关参考实现，不是 SDK 而是协议层——你的 Agent 只需发 J。
why_en: It's a protocol-level gateway, not a library—your agent just speaks JSON-RPC and joins a peer-to-peer agent mesh.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 JSON-RPC 2.0 点对点通信，不含服务发现、鉴权或消息路由；需要你自行实现 Agent 身份注册和网络。
limit_en: Only JSON-RPC 2.0 peer-to-peer; no discovery, auth, or routing. You must handle identity and topology yourself—otherwise local loopback only.
